title: Absolute junk - does not work
text: Absolute junk - does not work. This pump does not fit on my reusable 5 gallon primo water jug.  The pump's plastic nut does not screw onto the threaded rod, so the pump cannot be secured to the top of the water jug.  The plastic is soft, lightweight, flimsy, and dirty as molded (there are dark specs inside the white plastic that cannot be cleaned off).  This is a bad knockoff of a standard primo hand pump.  Avoid.
